title: Verify: Palette Tailwind colour export unit tests
summary: Unit tests for paletteTailwindColors and tailwind.config pal
description: Test the Tailwind export against the palette.
acceptance_criteria: Tests assert every palette colour appears once in paletteTailwindColors.
Tests assert tailwind config exposes pal and keeps old tokens.

steps.action: Create the file importing PALETTE and paletteTailwindColors from '../src/lib/palette'. Add test 'flattens to every palette colour once' asserting Object.values(paletteTailwindColors).flatMap(Object.values) sorted equals [...PALETTE] sorted.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/paletteTailwind.test.ts

steps.action: Import tailwindConfig from '../tailwind.config'. Add test asserting tailwindConfig.theme?.extend?.colors?.pal toEqual paletteTailwindColors and colors.background toBe 'hsl(var(--background))'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/paletteTailwind.test.ts
